text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A day in the life of Fuji Kiseki is full 
of sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Fuji-senpai~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hello, good morning! Seeing your smiling 
face first thing in the morning brings me 
joy--

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Oops, stay still for a second, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Alright, got it!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh, umm, what...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"There's a cute petal on you. Fufu, maybe 
it mistook you for a fairy?"

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, healing the Umamusume 
across the dorm with a smile—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
F-Fuji-sama! Um, I baked some cookies in 
home economics today... and, well, if 
you'd like some...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you sure? I'll savor every bite, 
thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-I ended up giving it to them~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Fuji, honestly, just how 
many of those have you received today?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Umm, ...maybe five?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
F-Five of 'em!? Whoa, is today Valentine's 
or somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpaaai, please take these cookies!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, mine too-! I made it while thinking 
all about you, Fuji-senpai-!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, what cute little ponies! No 
need to rush, though—I'm not going 
anywhere."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By day, captivating Umamusume all across 
the academy—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Kya! Fuji-sama is gazing up at the starry 
sky all by herself...! How dreamy!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, little pony! What a coincidence to run 
into you on a night like this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Care to do some stargazing together? The 
stars are lovely tonight."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
N-No way! Someone like me would just get 
in the way!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. In fact, it'll just add a 
wonderful memory to this scenery.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Won't you give me your memories together?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Kyaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At night, she captures the hearts of 
passing Umamusume. Fuji Kiseki's day 
is—truly full of brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...? Did someone call for me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry for intruding!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, oh, a pony-chan! Your voice was so 
beautiful, I thought you were an angel.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to sit next to me? The 
night sky looks exceptionally beautiful 
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Kyaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At night, she captures the hearts of 
passing Umamusume. Fuji Kiseki's day 
is—truly full of brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, that's no good. A passing shower. 
Perhaps I should call it a night for 
stargazing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Hey there, little pony! It looks like 
it's started raining, wanna walk back 
together?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Eep, y-yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At night, she captures the hearts of 
passing Umamusume. Fuji Kiseki's day 
is—truly full of brilliance."
